partition_seed: job seed; deterministic lexicographic rows, no shuffled training
phase_7_1: one selected seed0 job; fresh complete online training and 15 final cells; default NESTED_seed0; run CADIC_seed0/FIRST_ORDER_seed0 separately for matched quick comparison
phase_7_2: same selected seed0 job: 105 missing cells from saved states, no training; preserve final15 cells
phase_7_3: one registered job per invocation; fresh remaining methods/seeds or resume; complete120-cell matrix; never retrain an already completed job
output_scope: one selected job plus common preflight/study locks per evidence ZIP; other jobs remain separate outputs
p_ap_definition: sklearn.average_precision_score on all224x224 pixels per category, then arithmetic macro across all15 categories; p_aupr is an explicit historical alias
image_score: full CADIC Eq9, b9; greater means more anomalous
map: raw28x28 patch distances ->224x224 CPU FP32 bilinear align_corners=false; no smoothing/normalization
mask: raw nonzero, direct224 nearest; retain anomalous image label if tiny mask erases; raw empty/mismatched masks fail
undefined_metrics: fail and preserve evidence; never silently drop a category
checkpoint: every8images, each task boundary, pause and true stream end; no task flush or reset; finalize once only after all3599images
evaluation: read-only scientific state, only learned-history triangular cells; raw patches/scores/labels/masks saved per8images for independent recomputation

bootstrap.paired: same image multiplicities for methods and finite seeds
bootstrap.superiority: both primary paired lower CI bounds >0
bootstrap.degenerate_pixel_draw: AP=0 if resampled positive pixel mass is zero; never redraw/drop
bootstrap.noninferiority: both paired lower CI bounds strictly greater than -0.02

failure_policy: technical/nonfinite failures stop and export; no auto-retune, early stopping or score changes after test
anomaly_metrics_status: development_exposed_MVTec; full data/seed/method coverage needed before complete-study claims
visa: not runnable in this delivery; fresh confirmation protocol/source freeze required
replaycad: not integrated into this study without matched independent artifacts
order_studies: not registered in v5.1 study; future separately frozen experiment
